description_en: Taḥdhãlibi Bāhāḥ can be accessed via a narrow alleyway that runs underneath a residential house, to the north of the way from Uku Bāhāḥ (LAL2260) to Ubāhā Bahī (LAL2280). The main shrine of thebāhāḥis a plastered structure that is raised above the ground on a plinth. The roof of the temple has astūpaas its finial, and the temple structure itself is decorated with pilasters at each corner. The main sanctum faces west, and its entrance is emphasised by the triangular motif that sits above it. A smalldharmadhātu maṇḍala(45 cm high) and avajradhātu caitya(145 cm high) that sits on a square base of 120 cm are both lined up centrally to the west of the main shrine. This ensemble of monuments can be found towards the south-eastern corner of the courtyard. The courtyard measures 11.7 m × 9.2 m and is paved inteliatiles. A narrow alley to the north-western corner leads on to the Dune Bāhāḥ (LAL2300).Generally, this place is not referred to as abāhāḥ; instead, local residents call it alibi/coka(courtyard).Locke(1985) also does not include this monument in his list ofvihāras. However,Śākya(1994, 117-18)counts it as a branch of Oku Bāhāḥ (Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra,LAL2260). The structure of thisvihāradiffers from that of othervihāras. A cement-plastered shrine topped with astūpa-shaped pinnacle stands on the eastern side of the courtyard. There are no traditional carvings nor decorative objects in this shrine. Nāmasaṅgīti is enshrined in the sanctum as the main deity, and images of Mahākāla and Gaṇeśa have been attached respectively to the northern and the southern walls of the shrine. The shrine can be circumambulated via a narrow passage.A largely effaced stone inscription stands at the southeast corner of thecaitya.Śākya(1994, 117-18) has identified the date of the inscription as NS 718. However, the inscription is now mostly illegible and so the date could not be confirmed.
description_ne: रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार (ओकुबाहा:) पस्ने ढोकाको सामुन्ने रहेको गणेश मन्दिरको सँगै रहेको गल्लीबाट भित्र पसेपछि त:धंलिबि बाहा:मा पुगिन्छ । स्थानीयहरू यसलाई बाहा: नभनी लिबि(चोक) मात्र मान्छन् । लक (१९८५) ले यसलाई विहारको सूचीमा समावेश गरेका छैनन् । तर शाक्य(1994, 117-18)ले यसलाई रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार (ओकु बाहाः)को शाखा विहार मानेका छन् ।अन्य विहारभन्दा यो विहारको स्वरूप पनि फरक छ । चोकको पूर्वी भागमा रहेको सिमेन्ट प्लाष्टर गरिएको मन्दिरभित्र मूल देवताको रूपमा पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी नामसंगीति स्थापना गरिएको छ । विहारको मूल देवतालाई स्थानीयहरू क्वा:पा:द्य: पनि भन्दैनन् र मन्दिरमा कुनै परम्परागत कला देखिँदैन । सिमेन्ट प्लाष्टर गरिएको छानामाथि प्लाष्टर गरिएको चैत्यलाई गजूरको रूपमा राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको पछाडि ठाउँ खाली नै छ र त्यहाँबाट मन्दिरको प्रदक्षिणा गर्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिरको उत्तरतर्फको भित्तामा महाकाल र दक्षिणतर्फको भित्तामा गणेश स्थापना गरिएको छ । विहार परिसरमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल र एउटा वज्रधातु चैत्य रहेको छ । वज्रधातु चैत्यको पूर्व-दक्षिण कुनामा विहार स्थापनासम्बन्धी शिलापत्र राखिएको छ । सो शिलापत्र जीर्ण भइसकेको छ र सम्वत् कुँदिएको भाग पनि खिइसकेको छ । शाक्य(1994, 117-18)ले यसको मिति नेसं ७१८ दिएका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
references: REFERENCES Pruscha, Carl, ed. Kathmandu Valley: The Preservation of Physical Environment and Cultural Heritage, Protective Inventory . Vol. 2. Vienna: Anton Schroll, 1975. Śākya, Hemrāja. Śivadevasaṃskārita Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra: Chagū Adhyayana . Lalitpur, 1994.

historical_events.event_description: A Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala was constructed by Kiraśīrāja.
The Bāhāḥ was constructed by Śākyavaṃśa Dhanasiṃha.
